title: What?
label: ch:zh-shenme
canDo: I can write 什 and 么, ask 什么 to mean what, use it on its own to get something repeated, judge that it is blunt with a stranger, and I know its two characters carry the word's sound rather than its meaning.

payoff.summary: The first exchange in the track that goes wrong -- one speaker mishears -- and the first the reader can repair, which matters more than another memorised line because it is what keeps a conversation alive when the Mandarin runs out.
